title: refactor: rename lib/dependencies/Harmony* files to ESM*
body:
**Summary**

<!-- Explain the **motivation** for making this change. What existing problem does the pull request solve? -->
<!-- Try to link to an open issue for more information. -->
<!-- Any other information related to changes. -->

This PR renames the `lib/dependencies/Harmony*.js` files to `ESM*.js` and the bindings that require them, with `registerLegacyRequest` keeping pre-rename cache packs restorable due to `Harmony` is the early name for ES modules.

Some public names (class names, `webpack.dependencies.HarmonyImportDependency`, `RuntimeGlobals.harmonyModuleDecorator`, build meta and parser state fields, bundle comments) are unchanged and marked `TODO in the next major release` for renaming then.

`webpack/lib/dependencies/Harmony*` deep paths are recorded under `removed` in `tooling/deep-webpack-imports.json`, as their only importers are webpack-4-only.
